A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
HIV drug resistance testing is an important tool in the management of HIV-infected patients.
in Latvia, as in other countries, HIV drug resistance is an emerging problem and should be considered in clinical practice.
the prevalence of HIV drug resistance in Latvia is not high and is comparable with the prevalence in Europe.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the prevalence of HIV-1 drug resistance is increasing in Latvia and that HIV drug resistance testing should be implemented into routine practice in Latvia.
the prevalence of resistance-associated mutations among HIV-infected patients in Latvia is high and the main problem in the treatment of HIV infection is the development of drug resistance.
in order to prevent the emergence and spread of HIV drug resistance in Latvia, we need to improve the quality of antiretrovirus therapy.
